verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's REST API lets an agent read nexus (Get Nexus for Org), create registrations, and list filings by date, status, or registration ID, so the core read-and-act loop exists through the API. The official MCP server is docs-only: it never proxies API calls or sees credentials, so it cannot read or act on tax posture. API keys support expiry and rotation, but there is no evidence of permission-scoped credentials. missing for 10: accrued-liability read evidence, an MCP surface that acts on account data, scoped/least-privilege API credentials, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Get a list of all nexuses for the organization.
The Create Registration API allows users to create a new registration for tracking and managing tax filings efficiently across multiple jurisdictions.
The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.
The Get Filings By Registration ID API retrieves all filings associated with a specific registration ID.
Choose when the key should expire: Never, One Month, Six Month, or One Year.
